153:t_1:3.en: ～$$オーブ連合首長国$$　Military Headquarters～

153:t_1:5.en:
$$大統領$$
「Unfortunately, our request for talks was rejected. The $$新地球皇国$$ appears unwilling to sit down at the negotiating table with us.」

153:t_1:6.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Do they intend to keep fighting until they've wiped out our forces...?」

153:t_1:7.en:
$$大統領$$
「Reports from various sources say the Empire's invasion aims to extract the Earth's energy.」

153:t_1:8.en:
$$大統領$$
「They also say that the Earth could collapse as a result.」

153:t_1:10.en:
$$大統領$$
「We apparently have no choice but to fight.」

153:t_1:12.en:
$$大統領$$
「Representative $$アスハ$$... People we might call the Earth's conscience are now gathered in $$オーブ$$.」

153:t_1:13.en:
$$大統領$$
「Leave the fighting to me and the $$連邦軍$$, and think about the world that will follow.」

153:t_1:15.en:
$$大統領$$
「Without hope for the future, we cannot overcome the present. You will become that hope.」

153:t_1:17.en:
$$大統領$$
「That is why we cannot let the Empire learn your whereabouts. I'll keep contact to a minimum from now on.」

153:t_1:18.en:
$$大統領$$
「$$カガリ$$... The next time we meet, I'd like to take our time discussing peace with you, Princess $$マリナ$$, and the others.」

153:t_1:19.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I believe... that day will come...」

153:t_1:20.en:
$$大統領$$
「So do I. ...Then... I wish us both success.」

153:t_1:22.en:
$$キサカ$$
「...Representative, may I have a moment?」

153:t_1:24.en:
$$キサカ$$
「They have to shake off the Empire's pursuers first, so I believe it will still be some time before they arrive here.」

153:t_1:25.en:
$$カガリ$$
「$c is our hope for defeating the Empire. We must protect them at all costs...」

153:t_1:27.en:
$$キサカ$$
「An executive from $$アナハイム$$ is requesting contact with us.」

153:t_1:32.en: ～$$オーブ連合首長国$$　Chief Representative's Residence　Conference Room～

153:t_1:33.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...A pleasure to meet you, Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$. I am $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$.」

153:t_1:34.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I've heard much about you. ...So, what brings you here today?」

153:t_1:35.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I'll come straight to the point. I would like you to hand $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$ over to us.」

153:t_1:36.en:
$$カガリ$$
「...What on earth are you talking about?」

153:t_1:37.en:
$$マーサ$$
「There's no need to hide it any longer, Representative. I know she's taken refuge here with Princess $$マリナ$$, Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$, and the others.」

153:t_1:39.en:
$$マーサ$$
「We know our way around... We have a suitable information network of our own.」

153:t_1:40.en:
$$カガリ$$
「It was Senator $$ローナン・マーセナス$$...」

153:t_1:41.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh heh... Please don't be so openly hostile. I... feel a certain affinity with you, Representative.」

153:t_1:42.en:
$$カガリ$$
「You feel an affinity with me?」

153:t_1:43.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$... You succeeded your father, Mr. $$ウズミ・ナラ・アスハ$$, as representative of the $$オーブ連合首長国$$...」

153:t_1:44.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I sympathize with the difficult path you face.」

153:t_1:45.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm doing this because I choose to.」

153:t_1:46.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It's all right, Representative. I understand that you, too, are a victim of a world ruled by men's logic.」

153:t_1:48.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes... You and I are the same.」

153:t_1:53.en: ～$$オーブ連合首長国$$　Inside the Chief Representative's Residence～

153:t_1:56.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you for your concern, $$マリナ$$. But I'm all right.」

153:t_1:57.en:
$$マリナ$$
「$$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$... Do you know her?」

153:t_1:58.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Yes... I met her when I was in North America.」

153:t_1:59.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I, too, met her once, unofficially. She's a strong woman.」

153:t_1:60.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「In both the good and bad senses of the word.」

153:t_1:62.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「But her strength is dangerous. Trying to solve everything through power also means seeking greater power.」

153:t_1:66.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「She must be trying to gain greater power now by securing the Box.」

153:t_1:67.en:
$$マリナ$$
「You told us, $$ミネバ$$, that it has enough power to shake the $$地球連邦$$ of one of the worlds that made up $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

153:t_1:68.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「But that concerns only one world... What meaning does it have in this multiverse now?」

153:t_1:69.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have no idea, since I don't know what the Box truly is. But I do have an idea of what it means.」

153:t_1:71.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I mean the group called $$クロノ$$, which existed in both $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ and is said to have manipulated history from the shadows.」

153:t_1:72.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I've heard that protecting $$ラプラスの箱$$ is their doctrine.」

153:t_1:73.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「People from $$ＡＤＷ$$ are also trying to protect the Box that existed in $$ＵＣＷ$$...」

153:t_1:74.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Furthermore, $$クロノ$$ was in league with $$ジェミニス$$, the masterminds behind the $$時獄戦役$$.」

153:t_1:76.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「They must aim to secure $$ラプラスの箱$$ to curry favor with $$クロノ$$... and, through them, $$サイデリアル$$.」

153:t_1:77.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But I don't know whether that is $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$' collective will or $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$'s personal decision...」

153:t_1:79.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Avoiding battle and peace are similar, but different. Submission to invaders, especially out of selfish self-preservation, is tantamount to betraying the people.」

153:t_1:80.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「I agree with Vice Minister $$リリーナ$$. We cannot overlook an act that endangers so many people for personal gain.」

153:t_1:81.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What do you think, $$マリナ$$?」

153:t_1:83.en:
$$マリナ$$
「But I have no intention of rejecting the resolve of those who fight to protect what they cherish.」

153:t_1:84.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you, $$マリナ$$. You too, Vice Minister $$リリーナ$$ and Vice Minister $$ナナリー$$.」

153:t_1:85.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I will never forget the brief time I've spent here in $$オーブ$$.」

153:t_1:87.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is also seeking $$ラプラスの箱$$. And I've heard they've already joined hands with the Empire.」

153:t_1:88.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I cannot let either $$アナハイム$$ or $$ネオ・ジオン$$ have $$ラプラスの箱$$. For the sake of human dignity, too.」
